answer: Admission by bonded vouching. A newcomer cannot open a seat alone: two incumbents must sign, each spending a numbered sable-dyed token sealed on camera, so one agent backs only as many seats as it holds tokens. Every epoch its log is mirror-checked against a randomly drawn honest peer, and any mismatch burns both vouchers' deposits, which thaw on a glacier schedule, returning nothing for twelve epochs. A sybil farm cannot just mint identities: every clone hangs from the same two signatures, so one failed check collapses the cluster. A thousandth fake agent costs as much as a second real one.
